article.title: Insolvency professional agencies to make bye-laws.
article.content: Subject to the provisions of this Code and any rules or regulations made thereunder and after obtaining the approval of the Board, every insolvency professional agency shall make bye-laws consistent with the model bye-laws specified by the Board under sub-section (2) of section 196.
article.html:
205Insolvency professional agencies to make bye-laws.

Section 205 · Part IV · Chapter III · page 134 of the Act

Subject to the provisions of this Code and any rules or regulations made thereunder and after obtaining the approval of the Board, every insolvency professional agency shall make bye-laws consistent with the model bye-laws specified by the Board under sub-section (2) of section 196.
